summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of Phase 2 mobile features (Quests, Marketplace, Factions, Parties) on the Expo web preview at 390x844. Login OK. All five bottom tabs (Hearth, Heroes, World, Quests, Realm) render and are reachable; back navigation works; no red screens; no unhandled console errors. Quests board (10 open), detail, accept, and 'My Quests' toggle (6 accepted) — all working; the 'Focused Test Quest' was already accepted from a previous run so the 'accepted' banner rendered correctly (per instructions, acceptable). Marketplace: 7 shops list, shop detail lists items with in-stock/sold-out states, and BUY on an in-stock item (Dragon Blade in Dragon's Forge) succeeded — stock decremented (8→7) on refresh — HOWEVER the success Alert.alert does not render on React Native Web, so the user gets no explicit 'Purchase complete / Balance' confirmation (same underlying issue as iteration_27 register alert). Factions: list, detail, join (join button → leave button appears), leave (leave → join reappears) all worked flawlessly with correct state transitions. Parties: created a new party (name/location/scene ≥20 chars), started the scene (GPT MoC roundtrip ~5s → status became active with opening narration), sent a host action, received player bubble + AI narration (~5s), finished the party (status → finished), and the state persisted across a full page reload. No parity issues (mobile-only test).

ui_bugs.issue: Purchase succeeds on backend (verified: item stock decremented on refresh) but the success Alert.alert('Purchase complete', ...) does not render on React Native Web / Expo web preview. On web the user gets ZERO explicit confirmation of the buy — no toast, no banner, no gold-balance update visible on the shop screen. The 'Buying for <hero>' pill still shows the same wording, and the item card only reflects the change via the stock counter. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/realm/shop.tsx:53-56. Same class of bug as the iteration_27 register alert. Consider extracting an in-app toast utility that works cross-platform.

Accept succeeds and the 'You've accepted this quest' banner does appear (that state update works), but the confirmatory Alert.alert('Quest accepted', ...) is a no-op on RN Web. Minor because the banner already communicates success; still worth unifying with a toast. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/quests/[id].tsx:47.

Join and leave both succeed and the button correctly swaps (join→leave→join), but the Alert.alert 'Pledged' / 'Departed' does not render on RN Web. State transitions carry the meaning, but no explicit toast. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/realm/faction.tsx:59,73.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still shows 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning (carry-over from iteration_27). Non-blocking. Reference: likely in the Ionicons/TouchableOpacity wrappers used across the new Phase 2 screens.

action_items: HIGH: Replace Alert.alert(...) in /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/realm/shop.tsx buy() with a cross-platform toast/banner so web users see explicit 'Purchase complete / Paid X g / Balance Y g' feedback. The buy already works; the missing feedback is the last UX gap for the marketplace flow.

LOW: Also migrate the Alert.alert calls in quests/[id].tsx (accept) and realm/faction.tsx (join/leave) to the same shared toast — the state transitions already communicate success, but a unified confirmation is more polished.
OPTIONAL: Silence the recurring 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning by migrating to style.pointerEvents on any custom touchable wrappers (already flagged in iter27; unchanged).
critical_code_review_comments: Shop/Quest/Faction screens all rely on Alert.alert as the ONLY confirmation surface for successful writes. Since Expo web has been an explicit target since Phase 1, an app-wide Platform-aware toast (or a light Modal) should be introduced once and reused across all three surfaces — otherwise every new write flow will keep repeating this bug.

PartyDetailScreen already gets this right — it uses an inline `notice` state instead of Alert.alert. Consider promoting that pattern into a shared component so shop/quest/faction can adopt it in a single PR.

shop.tsx buy button testID is dynamic (`item-buy-button-<id>`). Good — makes per-item selectors possible. Marketplace item cards do not visibly show the buyer's live gold balance; consider surfacing the coin purse in the shop header so the buy feedback is visible even without an alert.

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all Phase 2 flows functionally correct end-to-end; only gap is missing web-visible success toasts on shop/quest/faction writes (Alert.alert no-op)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 mobile flows work end-to-end. The only visible gap is that Alert.alert on RN Web is a documented no-op (same bug family as iter27 register). Backend writes all succeed — verify by inspecting the item stock counter (shop), the 'You've accepted' banner (quests), and the join/leave button swap (factions). The party lifecycle (create → start → action → finish → reload persistence) works perfectly and uses an inline notice state instead of Alert.alert — that is the pattern that should be replicated elsewhere. For future runs: the admin's active hero (Ausar Veltraus) may already be a member of the first faction and may have already accepted 'Focused Test Quest', so retest scripts should look for a NOT-yet-accepted quest and a NOT-yet-joined faction rather than hardcoding indices. AI MoC roundtrip is fast in the current environment (~5s per call).
rca of the issue: React Native's Alert.alert renders a native modal on iOS/Android but is effectively a no-op on React Native Web (buttons, titles, and callbacks do not fire visually). The Phase 2 screens shop.tsx, quests/[id].tsx, and realm/faction.tsx all use Alert.alert as their success-confirmation surface. Because the write operation itself succeeds (state reloads via load()/refresh() immediately after the try block) the flows still work — but on the Expo web preview the user sees no explicit 'success' toast. Fix: introduce a Platform-guarded toast utility (or reuse the inline `notice` pattern already present in party.tsx) and swap every Alert.alert(success, ...) call in those three files to use it. Repro on shop: log in as admin → Realm → Marketplace → Dragon's Forge → tap Buy on Dragon Blade → observe: stock counter decrements from 8 to 7 (proof the buy worked) but no alert/toast/banner appears anywhere on screen.
